messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert 1704129876 - Hosted API EU: request_queue_length > 18k and p99 latency > 6.2s for 3m. Autoscaler failing to reconcile. Automatically tagged severity=P2. Pager: @oncall-rotation

maya: seeing the same in grafana. p95 ~ 1.8s, p99 ~ 6.4s. Error 504s start to climb. traffic spike from a partner (~3x baseline)

rahul (oncall): I'm on it. pulling recent autoscaler logs and provisioner events

sofia: leaving a note: customer-impacting. A few user teams reported timeouts. I'll notify CS if we need to escalate.

rahul: tailing provisioner logs:
```
2024-01-01T18:05:01Z provisioner: scale_loop: desired=120 available=64 max_quota=70 error=quota_exceeded
2024-01-01T18:05:12Z provisioner: create_instance failed: rate_limit: TooManyRequests
2024-01-01T18:06:00Z autoscaler: reconcile_timeout, skipping update
```

denis (infra): quota_exceeded on the cloud side. We hit soft-account limit for EU GPUs. There's a pending request to increase but it's not approved yet.

maya: request backlog by priority: total 18,432; customer-tier=5002; free-tier=12,300; internal=1130

sofia: @cs-bot please prepare a short message: "We are experiencing increased latencies and timeouts in EU region; engineering investigating." Keep it light.

cs-bot: Draft posted to CS channel. Copy saved.

rahul: quick mitigation options: 1) fallback lower-priority requests to cheaper model (cpu fallback) 2) route VIP customers to dedicated pools in us-west as temporary 3) emergency throttle on anonymous/free-tier keys

sofia: recommend #2 for high-touch customers and #3 for free-tier. notify legal? not yet.

rahul: implementing throttles now. patching rate-limit map:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/configs/rate-limits -d '{"scope":"global","rule":"free-tier","qps":0.5}' -H "X-Run-As:ops"
```

ops-bot: config deploy succeeded (deploy id 20240101-ops-77). New rule applied across edge gateways.

maya: deploying a temporary route rule to send model requests for select tenant IDs to dedicated-uswest-01:
```
route set --tenant 2345,4567 --target dedicated-uswest-01 --reason "eu gpu saturation emergency"
```

deploy-bot: route update queued. some routes blocked due to CIDR mismatch will require config tweak.

rahul: autoscaler logs show backoff due to rate limit errors contacting cloud API - we need to retry or use pre-warmed instances. Increasing autoscaler retry window and enabling prewarm pool.

sofia: can we enable prewarm for EU with smaller instance types? cost hit but immediate relief.

denis: can spin up 6 prewarm g4dn-small equivalents from spare credits. doing now.

denis: spun up 6 nodes, kube-ready in ~90s. provisioner reports available=70 now.

maya: still seeing queue decline but p99 still at 4.1s. many free-tier requests were shed by the new rate limits.

rahul: enabling degraded-mode routing so we favor low-latency cached responses and reduce KV cache invalidation frequency. patch:
```
config set degraded_mode=true --kv_cache_ttl=120
```

ops-bot: degraded-mode toggle accepted.

sofia: customer-impact check: VIP customers 1-3 routed to us-west. CS notified VIP-ops. No SLA breach yet but close. I've queued an email to top 10 tenants.

maria (sre): observed a separate issue: provisioner leader election was flapping earlier which slowed scale-up; fixed leader timeout param `--leader-lease=15s -> 45s`

rahul: good catch, thanks. That plus prewarm should steady the queue. keep monitoring p95/p99 for 10m.

maya: quick metric dump (snip):
- queue: 18.4k -> 6.9k over 12m
- p95: 1.8s -> 0.9s
- p99: 6.4s -> 2.2s
- 504s/min: 320 -> 45

sofia: thumbs. Any residual customer-facing retries? CS: some users see intermittent 502s earlier but now mostly recovered.

rahul: documenting runbook's temporary steps. I'll start a short incident report after stabilization.

maria: recommend follow-up: request permanent quota increase for EU, improve autoscaler retry/backoff, add prewarm config in runbook, and implement better priority eviction policy so internal jobs don't crowd customer traffic.

sofia: scheduling postmortem tomorrow 10:00UTC and tagging product and legal. I'll create the incident ticket.

incident-bot: Incident 1704129876 updated: mitigations applied. current status: stabilizing. Severity to P3 candidate if metrics hold for 30m.

rahul: transitioning to day ops in 20m. handing off continued watch to @night-sre. I'll paste a short handoff below.

Handoff — rahul -> night-sre:
- current queue 6.9k, p99 2.2s
- prewarm nodes +6 active
- rate limits applied for free-tier
- VIP tenants routed to dedicated-uswest-01
- leader-lease increased
- watch metrics: queue length, p99, 504/min, provisioner errors

sofia: thanks. I'll leave the CS note open and ping again if we see regression.

night-sre: taking over. pls DM if it spikes again. :handshake: 

rahul: done. closing thread on my end once 30m stable. thanks team.
